about: docs/structure.md 12.0r. `pictures`: the texts a Photo (and the photo of a face(..)) draws and the ones it does not; a text is head + fill repeated up to len characters (tail at the end), so no picture is kept here. Run by crates/cancho-ui/tests/photo.rs against cancho_ui_ir::photo::picture_ok and by scripts/check-photo.js against the page's __cui_photo_ok. `valid`: a view (of component C) that must check. `refusals`: a view and the rule tag that refuses it. `values`: what a handler of a PhotoField may be told, for replay (trace-value-not-a-photo).
